text: Welcome to the teahouse. Climb the stair, drink the tea, look at the sea.

choices.text: Gus says you taught him to fight with his feet.

text: Gus? He came to me with a ladle in each hand and a temper like a stove. A cook's hands are for the pot. So we taught his legs instead.
It's the kitchen's way: low kick, high kick, the heel from above, and when they crowd you, down on your hands and sweep the floor with them.
I don't teach just anyone. Tomo, my pupil, will spar with you. Bare hands, no blades. Put him down and I'll teach you the rest.
Tomo! A guest wants to learn. Mind the teacups.
Tea from the far east, by way of Ysolde's junk and a great deal of arguing.
The keeper takes her lunch here every day and pays every other day. It evens out at the shrine.

bye.text: The sea's always there. So's the tea.
